records.title: Intensive Portuguese for Spanish and Other Romance Language Speakers
records.header: PORT 105 Intensive Portuguese for Spanish and Other Romance Language Speakers (5) A&H
records.text: PORT 105 Intensive Portuguese for Spanish and Other Romance Language Speakers (5) A&H Introduction to Portuguese for Spanish and other Romance language speakers. Students develop speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills, while also learning about history and culture in an engaging and welcoming learning environment. Satisfies foreign language requirement in combination with PORT 201. Prerequisite: either SPAN 203, SPAN 216, SPAN 301, SPAN 302, SPAN 303, SPAN 314, SPAN 315, or SPAN 316, any of which may be taken concurrently. Offered: W.

records.title: Brazilian, Portuguese and African Cultures
records.header: PORT 365 Brazilian, Portuguese and African Cultures (5-12, max. 15) A&H/SSc
records.text: PORT 365 Brazilian, Portuguese and African Cultures (5-12, max. 15) A&H/SSc Explores cultures of Brazil, Portugal, and Portuguese-speaking countries in Africa within the framework of cultural studies theory. Follows an interdisciplinary approach, drawing from readings, films, history, literature, arts, and anthropology, among others. Focuses on selected cultural aspects and countries. Taught in English. Offered: jointly with JSIS A 365; S.

records.title: Port-Language Track for Mapping Luso-Brazilian Cultures
records.header: PORT 366 Port-Language Track for Mapping Luso-Brazilian Cultures (2)
records.text: PORT 366 Port-Language Track for Mapping Luso-Brazilian Cultures (2) Language track option in Portuguese for intermediate or higher level students, in conjunction with PORT 365/JSIS A 365. Must be registered in PORT 365/JSIS A 365, to take this class. Explores readings and films/documentaries in the cultures of Brazil and the Portuguese-speaking world. Prerequisite: PORT 201 or permission of instructor. Offered: Sp.

records.title: Art, Activism, and the Environment in Brazil
records.header: PORT 370 Art, Activism, and the Environment in Brazil (5-12, max. 15) A&H/SSc
records.text: PORT 370 Art, Activism, and the Environment in Brazil (5-12, max. 15) A&H/SSc Explores the relationship between art, activism, and the environment, focusing on Brazil while making comparisons with other countries in Latin America, the United States, and Canada. Looks at the historical and social-political contexts of environmental activism in relation to arts, with special attention to literature, music, films, documentaries, and other visual arts.
